final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) as total_diff FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(total_diff) as overall_avg FROM category_stats) SELECT cs.category, cs.avg_remaining, cs.total_diff, cs.total_diff - oa.overall_avg as above_average FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa WHERE cs.total_diff > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY cs.category
